## Checklist

- [ ] New skill has `skills/<name>/SKILL.md` with correct frontmatter
- [ ] New skill has valid public metadata in `skills/<name>/skill.json`
- [ ] Tool names and REST fields match the live platform schema
- [ ] Examples use `.env` or `~/.dataspheres.env`, not embedded credentials
- [ ] Relevant Node.js and shell checks pass
- [ ] `bash install.sh --all --project <temp-dir> --copy` succeeds
- [ ] README skills table updated if new skill added
